manual.how: Open the text files in a browser and save them: https://ticdata.treasury.gov/resource-center/data-chart-center/tic/Documents/slt_table5.txt (latest 13 months), .../mfhhis01.txt (history from 2000) or .../slt_table1.txt (long-term securities by country). cache.why: Monthly releases revise the last months; data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: U.S. government work in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105).

citation: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Treasury International Capital (TIC) System, {dataset}, ticdata.treasury.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which measure? Major Foreign Holders counts all Treasury securities (bills, bonds and notes) in billions; SLT Table 1 counts long-term securities only (no bills), in millions, and also covers agency, corporate bonds and stocks. Default: Major Foreign Holders for 'how much debt does X hold'.
Which months? slt_table5 has the latest 13 months; mfhhis01 has March 2000 through the last full year. Default: the latest month, with the year-earlier month for comparison.
